text.description_html:
DWD-833/P5240, Polished Brass Grand Palais Door Pull

The Grand Palais Pull Plate is dripping with the beauty and splendor of the old world. Its elaborate styling makes it a truly gorgeous piece, perfect for the great palace of Paris, the doors of some of the top luxury hotels in the world, and even your home. The plate is 25-1/2 inches tall and 3-5/8 inches wide and the handle is 20-1/4 inches long, ensuring that it will make an elegant statement on any door. Bring the glory of the ornamented to your home with the Polished Brass Grand Palais Door Pull. Assembled and finished in the USA, it comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Thru-Bolted Mounted: Pull bolts through the door.

Also available: Matching Grand Palais Push Plate

Features and Specifications of the 833/P5241 Ornate Grand Palais Pull Plate:

  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Material: Brass
  • Plate Width: 3-5/8"
  • Plate Height: 25-1/2"
  • Handle Length center to center: 13-1/8"
  • Overall Handle Length: 20-1/4"
  • Handle Handle Projection: 3"
  • Handle Diameter: 1-3/16"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" Standard
  • Comes complete with matching finish screws and through bolts for easy installation.

Sold Individually
